mapper.select: SELECT embryo_code, tire_fabric_code1, tire_fabric_code2, tire_fabric_code3 FROM t_construction_version_info WHERE IFNULL(del_flag, 0) = 0

SELECT DISTINCT mdmp.FACTORY_CODE, mdmp.YEAR, mdmp.MONTH, mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AS MOULD_CODE, mdmp.BEGIN_DATE, mdmp.END_DAY, mmi.MOULD_NO, mmi.MOULD_AIR_TYPE FROM t_mdm_device_maintenance_plan mdmp INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info mmi ON mmi.MOULD_CODE = mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AND mmi.FACTORY_CODE = mdmp.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mdm_product_model_relation pmr ON pmr.MOULD_CODE = mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AND pmr.FACTORY_CODE = mdmp.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mp_product_require_plan prp ON prp.PRODUCT_CODE = pmr.PRODUCT_CODE AND IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE IFNULL(mdmp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mdmp.MACHINE_TYPE = 2 AND mdmp.PLAN_TYPE = 0 AND mdmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mdmp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mdmp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL}

SELECT DISTINCT mdmp.FACTORY_CODE, mdmp.YEAR, mdmp.MONTH, mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AS MOULD_CODE, mdmp.BEGIN_DATE, mdmp.END_DAY, mmi.MOULD_NO, mmi.MOULD_AIR_TYPE FROM t_mdm_device_maintenance_plan mdmp INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info mmi ON mmi.MOULD_CODE = mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AND mmi.FACTORY_CODE = mdmp.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mdm_product_model_relation pmr ON pmr.MOULD_CODE = mdmp.MACHINE_CODE AND pmr.FACTORY_CODE = mdmp.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mp_product_require_plan prp ON prp.PRODUCT_CODE = pmr.PRODUCT_CODE AND IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE IFNULL(mdmp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mdmp.MACHINE_TYPE = 2 AND mdmp.PLAN_TYPE = 0 AND mdmp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mdmp.BEGIN_DATE >= #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND mdmp.END_DAY <= #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT DISTINCT mus.FACTORY_CODE, mus.YEAR, mus.MONTH, mus.MOULD_CODE, mus.MOULD_TYPE, mmi.MOULD_NO, mmi.MOULD_AIR_TYPE FROM t_mdm_mould_use_status mus INNER JOIN t_mdm_model_info mmi ON mmi.MOULD_CODE = mus.MOULD_CODE AND mmi.FACTORY_CODE = mus.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mdm_product_model_relation pmr ON pmr.MOULD_CODE = mus.MOULD_CODE AND pmr.FACTORY_CODE = mus.FACTORY_CODE INNER JOIN t_mp_product_require_plan prp ON prp.PRODUCT_CODE = pmr.PRODUCT_CODE AND IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE mus.MOULD_STATUS = 1 AND mus.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mus.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND mus.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL}
SELECT count(1) AS count FROM T_LH_MACHINE_INFO tlmi WHERE IFNULL(tlmi.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND tlmi.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT tlmi.MAX_MOLD_NUM AS MOULD_NUMBER, count(1) AS GROUP_COUNT FROM T_LH_MACHINE_INFO tlmi WHERE IFNULL(tlmi.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND tlmi.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY tlmi.MAX_MOLD_NUM
SELECT count(1) AS count FROM t_mdm_molding_machine tmmm WHERE IFNULL(tmmm.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND tmmm.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
